title: Nou camp tour
text: If you are football fan, you are going to love this. Lots to see especially inside the museum. Stadium itself is out of bounds because of construction work, but otherwise very enjoyable
author: Aftab_A

title: Worth a Visit
text: A bit stressful finding our tour guide, as she did not stand out to us . But once we asked security where she was the tour was excellent. Our tour guide was very knowledgeable and made the tour fun, and inclusive. Even a non football fan like myself thoroughly enjoyed it. My son thought it was amazing. Well worth a visit .
author: Helen J

title: Great tour
text: Little bit of stress finding the guide . But once we did, the tour was great. Tour guide was very knowledgeable and made the tour fun and interesting, my son loved it . So did I and I don’t even like football
author: helenj2018

title: Very good
text: The experience was very good. The guide, was very helpful and gave out great information in many languages. The only thing I would say that wasn’t great, was it felt slightly rushed due to the crowding but that came down to fortune.
